items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: Well I started working with Chuck in 2000... next thing I knew I was in New York and we were at SIR playing.

ctx.x: Chazz Frichtel is multi-talented songwriter, vocalist, guitarist and bassist. He was born in Prospect, N.Y. and relocated to Los Angeles in the late 70s. He has played bass and toured with a long list of diverse artists including Michael McDonald, Chuck Mangione, Chaka Kahn and Christopher Cross. Chazz sang the theme song for the syndicated television series “Saved by the Bell” and his versatility enabled a rich career in the competitive music business.
Chazz was interviewed in Clinton, NY on June 13, 2016 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
